# calendar-query with a time-range that has only a start (what iOS sends,
# TECHNIK 1.5): a weekly series from 03.11.2026 and a single event after
# the start both match; an event before it does not. (go-webdav dropped
# series here.)
@seed calendar privat sport.ics weekly-tuesday.ics
@seed calendar privat zahnarzt.ics dentist.ics
@seed calendar privat vorbei.ics old-event.ics

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <C:calendar-query xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><D:prop><D:getetag/></D:prop><C:filter><C:comp-filter name="VCALENDAR"><C:comp-filter name="VEVENT"><C:time-range start="20261101T000000Z"/></C:comp-filter></C:comp-filter></C:filter></C:calendar-query>
< status 207
< responses 2
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/sport.ics d:getetag {etag:weekly-tuesday.ics}
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/zahnarzt.ics d:getetag {etag:dentist.ics}
< response-lacks /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/vorbei.ics

# Far after the start of the series: it still matches (no end), the
# single events not.
> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <C:calendar-query xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><D:prop><D:getetag/><C:calendar-data/></D:prop><C:filter><C:comp-filter name="VCALENDAR"><C:comp-filter name="VEVENT"><C:time-range start="20300101T000000Z"/></C:comp-filter></C:comp-filter></C:filter></C:calendar-query>
< status 207
< responses 1
< data /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/sport.ics weekly-tuesday.ics

# Only an end: what began before it.
> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <C:calendar-query xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><D:prop><D:getetag/></D:prop><C:filter><C:comp-filter name="VCALENDAR"><C:comp-filter name="VEVENT"><C:time-range end="20261101T000000Z"/></C:comp-filter></C:comp-filter></C:filter></C:calendar-query>
< status 207
< responses 1
< response-lacks /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/sport.ics
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/vorbei.ics d:getetag {etag:old-event.ics}

# No time-range: every event; comp/expand below calendar-data are not
# applied (the stored bytes come back).
> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <C:calendar-query xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><D:prop><D:getetag/><C:calendar-data><C:comp name="VCALENDAR"><C:comp name="VEVENT"><C:prop name="SUMMARY"/></C:comp></C:comp><C:expand start="20261101T000000Z" end="20261201T000000Z"/></C:calendar-data></D:prop><C:filter><C:comp-filter name="VCALENDAR"><C:comp-filter name="VEVENT"/></C:comp-filter></C:filter></C:calendar-query>
< status 207
< responses 3
< data /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/zahnarzt.ics dentist.ics
< data /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/vorbei.ics old-event.ics

# Only VEVENT is stored: a VTODO query is empty; a filter the server does
# not evaluate (SUMMARY) gives every event (the client filters).
> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <C:calendar-query xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><D:prop><D:getetag/></D:prop><C:filter><C:comp-filter name="VCALENDAR"><C:comp-filter name="VTODO"/></C:comp-filter></C:filter></C:calendar-query>
< status 207
< responses 0

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <C:calendar-query xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><D:prop><D:getetag/></D:prop><C:filter><C:comp-filter name="VCALENDAR"><C:comp-filter name="VEVENT"><C:prop-filter name="SUMMARY"><C:text-match>Zahnarzt</C:text-match></C:prop-filter></C:comp-filter></C:comp-filter></C:filter></C:calendar-query>
< status 207
< responses 3

# Bad filters: none, a time-range without start and end, a date that is no
